# API specification v1

<!-- Generated by npm run contracts. Edit schemas/routes/exporter, not this file. -->

## Implementation status

Only `GET /api/health` and `GET /api/bootstrap` work. Every business route is a typed **501 FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED** stub. Success examples below are the frozen target contract, not completed features. OpenAPI in `docs/openapi.json` is the handoff snapshot. Runtime `/openapi.json` exposes FastAPI contracts; this snapshot adds target security metadata and the internal agent protocol.

## Global rules

- All paths below include `/api`. JSON only; reject extra input fields. IDs are opaque strings, never array indexes. Never infer permission from a supplied ID.
- After P02: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for all business endpoints except login. No cookie sessions, browser role header, public registration, or arbitrary tool endpoint. Eight-hour server expiry; logout revokes token. Store hashes, not raw tokens/passwords.
- ISO date-only joining/deadline dates; UTC timestamps. Lists are `{items: [...]}`; empty is `[]`. Local fixture size is at most six hires; pagination is deferred. A case response returns at most the 100 newest timeline items chronologically; history remains in storage. Never silently truncate decision evidence.
- Unknown resource: 404. Existing out-of-scope resource: indistinguishable 404. Known in-scope record but wrong operation/role: 403. Missing/expired token: 401. Invalid shape: 422; stale version/state/policy or unsupported pack: 409. Unexpected server failures must be sanitized 500, never traceback/secret data.
- Duplicate same question answer or decision returns its existing accepted result. Different answer after ANSWERED or different decision after recorded decision: 409. Approval queues work, not execution success. Recheck inputs at execution.
- No endpoint may accept model credentials, model URLs, arbitrary SQL, actor IDs, source timestamps, or authoritative role claims from the browser.

## Error contract

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "STALE_VERSION",
    "message": "Inputs changed; request a new proposal.",
    "details": []
  }
}
```

Stable codes: FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED (501), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), FORBIDDEN (403), NOT_FOUND (404), STALE_VERSION / INVALID_STATE / POLICY_REVIEW_REQUIRED (409), VALIDATION_ERROR (422), DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL_ERROR (500). Token/credential input is never echoed in error details.

## Source-record authority and semantics

`PUT /hires/{hire_id}/sources/{source_id}`: expected_version=0 creates an absent record at v1; positive expected_version conditionally updates that exact record. Body category must match the existing record. Server sets source_system=demo, external_id=source_id, actor and time. Conflicting identity/category/version is 409. Atomically invalidate dependent current checks and create sanitized audit. This is a simulated-source control, not an unrestricted agent mutation. Unassigned inventory is seeded, not created through this endpoint.

| Category | Permitted writer | Additional invariant |
|---|---|---|
| documents | Own EMPLOYEE submits, scoped HR reviews | Employee can set SUBMITTED only; REVIEWED requires HR. Review does not establish signature/legal authenticity. |
| equipment | Scoped IT | HANDED_OVER requires matching hire assignee and handover_at; RESERVED requires assignee, no handover_at. AVAILABLE requires null assignee/handover. Prevent a source write from moving another hire's device. |
| payroll | Scoped PAYROLL | setup_confirmed implies profile_created. |
| benefits | Scoped BENEFITS; own EMPLOYEE may only record DECLINED | ENROLLED needs benefits-owner confirmation; decline satisfies only an explicitly permitting policy. |
| training | Scoped TRAINING | Record completion, not competence. |
| manager | Assigned MANAGER | Active supported buddy user; non-empty plan. |

### `GET /api/health`

Read database-backed readiness

**Authority:** Public minimal local health; no private records, keys, paths or model calls.

**Parameters:** none.

**Request body:** none.

**Success 200:** Health

```json

  "status": "ok",
  "database": "ok",
  "schema_version": 1
}
```

**Errors:** 503; global meanings above.

## Internal agent contract (not a public endpoint)

`NextStep` has one `next_step` discriminated union: read, ask, propose, finish, escalate. No read arguments/hire ID exist; scope is supplied by the server. This is the final-guide illustration simplified into a provider-compatible object envelope. Ask recipient_role is a suggestion; the server resolves an authorized recipient. Proposal reviewer, versions, execution and verification are server-only.

```json
{
  "next_step": {
    "step": "read",
    "tool": "get_equipment_status",
    "reason_summary": "Check independent assignment evidence."
  }
}
```

## All shared JSON schemas

Required keys, nullable fields, enums, bounds and discriminators below are normative. JSON examples use illustrative IDs, not guaranteed seeded records.

### AcceptedWork

```json
{
  "properties": {
    "case_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 80,
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$",
      "title": "Case Id"
    },
    "work_item_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 80,
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$",
      "title": "Work Item Id"
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "case_id",
    "work_item_id"
  ],
  "title": "AcceptedWork"
}
```

### ActionResult

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "action_id": {
      "maxLength": 80,
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$",
      "title": "Action Id",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "state": {
      "enum": [
        "PENDING",
        "RUNNING",
        "SUCCEEDED",
        "FAILED",

      ],
      "title": "State",

    "observed": {
      "additionalProperties": {

          {
            "type": "string"

          {
            "type": "integer"

          {
            "type": "boolean"

          {
            "type": "null"

    "evidence": {
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Evidence"
```
